annotations.title: Translate a bra size between brands

description: Translate a band and cup size she wears at one brand (for example 34DD at Wacoal) into another brand's label, through Measured Size's base size. Use this only when the shopper has no measurements; measurements give a better answer. Translated sizes are rated no higher than Good Match: tell her so. It refuses letter sizes (S/M/L), labels the first brand's record doesn't give, and brands that sell letter sizes only, with the reason.

from_brand.description: The brand whose size she knows.

size.description: Her band and cup size at from_brand, as that brand labels it.

to_brand.description: The brand to translate the size into.

name: translate_bra_size
title: Translate a bra size between brands
